info.title: Conversation Service
info.description: This is the main service for the application. It manages all conversations with the chatbot, including user questions and the responses generated. Depending on the detected intent, data inquiries may be exchanged with the IS-U system through the MCF interface.

x-sap-shortText: This service handles all conversations with the AI agent.

post.summary: This is the conversation endpoint for the AI agent. A session must be created before sending any messages. See createSession.

sessionId.description: The system generates a unique ID identifying the chat session, which must be used in all subsequent requests to maintain context and track the conversation.

input.description: The input is the message sent by the user during the chat session, serving as the basis for the AI agentâs reply.

message.description: The message field contains an array of response messages generated by the agent.

type.description: It defines the semantic category of the message, indicating the context on which the content is based.

content.description: A JSON string containing different properties, which differ depending on the message type.

Conversation.MessageType.description: The message type can be one of the listed values. The message type controls which properties are available in the field content. The field content is a json string.
